general_defect_index.general_index_formula: nu=b1-b2=2r-k, where r negative and k-r positive boundary spheres
general_defect_index.vectorlike_obstruction: For any k>=3 with at least one positive boundary, every nontrivial flat character necessarily has b2>=1. A net index three alone never yields a clean fully chiral spectrum in those charged sectors.
general_defect_index.fixed_input: The k punctures, boundary signs and smooth lens-space topology are assumed. This generalizes the parallel k5 model but does not derive a defect geometry or physical family count.

order_seven_Wilson.Wilson_test: diag(zeta7 I3,zeta7^2 I2) has det=1 and kills all SO10 10+10bar off-diagonal generators. With an appropriate Psi phase, the full E6 centralizer has dimension14=SM12 plus 2 abelian gauge generators.
order_seven_Wilson.topological_tradeoff: The parallel punctured lens L(4,1) has pi1=C4; removing spherical defects does not change pi1. It therefore cannot carry a nontrivial C7 character. On the different full Klein A1 stratum quotient Q/H6, the involution acts -I on H1(Q,F7)=F7^2; since 7 does not divide 6, finite-cover transfer gives H1(Q/H6,F7)=0. It also cannot carry a flat C7 line character.
order_seven_Wilson.rank_obstruction: A single commuting torus Wilson line cannot lower the gauge-group rank6 of E6. Even order7 leaves at least SM12 plus 2 extra U1 gauge generators; further dynamical Higgs, inflow or singular boundary data required.
order_seven_Wilson.assumptions: Holonomy is chosen in SU5 x U1Psi inside compact E6; additional nonabelian orbifold projections or noncommuting Wilson collections are not covered.

E6_anomalies.caveat: These are necessary 4D local anomaly sums for three charged16_-3 chiral modules. The ordinary E6 fundamental27 branching 16_(+1)+10_(-2)+1_(+4) is NOT a charge-matched immediate cancellation for an adjoint16_(-3). Anomaly inflow, Stueckelberg/GS sectors, or new chirals need explicit construction.

modular_winding.stable_iff: y<=pi*(N0/N)/4 in this parent mixed-mode branch
modular_winding.warning: The invariant modular hyperbolic measure is not a cosmological probability distribution. String corrections and full KK spectrum unknown.

quantum_memory.IID_not_necessary_for_type1: If conditional success probabilities on each accepted trial satisfy P(X_i=1|history)<=p0, a uniform-variable coupling dominates the full count by Binomial(n,p0), even with adaptive temporal correlations.
quantum_memory.alternative_requirement: Similarly beta bound holds if every conditional success probability >=p1, not merely the unconditional mean.
quantum_memory.acceptance_bias_model: Per-trial success-versus-failure acceptance efficiency ratio <=kappa; null p0'=kappa/(kappa+2), alternative p1'=7/(7+8*kappa).
quantum_memory.device_scope: Entanglement breaking of an effective one-time input-output channel is not equivalent to classical multi-time process-tensor memory. Event-ready trials, reference independence, loss and per-history bounds require physical certification.
quantum_memory.literature_warning: Recent work shows even entanglement-breaking channels can be a quantum resource in genuine multitime processes; do not infer a universal quantum-memory classification from this one Choi test.
